why: Resume the main-sequence resolution check again for the late main sequence (evolve4-23 reached Xc 0.27 for 2.5 M_Ch at dX 0.01 and 0.10 for 4.0). The two 2.5 M_Ch dX 0.005 runs were stopped by the energy-books bar (1.08 for 10 models) at Xc 0.48; they resume with balmax=0.15 as diagnostic runs only. Findings so far: resolution moves the time at fixed Xc under 0.7%; pinned gravity's fix -7 to -9%; the books' 7-8% stretches persist at every resolution (a method error in stirred cores, not resolution).
